entries.description: Pi5 E2E audit identified resource and security hardening gaps: SSE currently runs globally and should be dashboard-only with adaptive polling by active clients; add baseline security headers; harden systemd unit and sudo scope; split SSE/non-SSE write timeout behavior; encrypt notification secrets and backup artifacts; and add trusted-proxy IP handling plus DB indexes for alert/action/session hot paths.

Production SSH audit on 192.168.1.29 shows repeated template runtime failures on hardware page: `Failed to execute template hardware.html: template: hardware-form.html:3:52: executing \"partials/hardware-form.html\" at <.CSRFToken>: can't evaluate field CSRFToken in type server.hardwarePageData`. This causes hardware UI rendering failures and repeated sudo/pironman calls in logs.

Root requirement for backup subsystem: it must be fully parameterizable from Settings as a first-class module (enabled flag, interval, retention count, local path, destination mode, encryption on/off, key reference, upload timeout/size). Current implementation is partially configurable; full operational control and security posture require complete settings-driven configuration with live apply and audited changes.
